# BD-xx — <feature name>

<!-- What problem this feature solves and for whom, in two or three sentences. -->

<!-- Who uses it (human, AI agent, script) and the concrete use cases, one per line. -->

<!-- Command syntax, flags, and example invocations with their exact output (text and --json). -->

<!-- Happy path as a Mermaid flowchart (```mermaid flowchart TD ...```), seen from the user's side. -->

<!-- Numbered rules BR-01, BR-02, ... that the DD must enforce. -->
